title: RegionRoute
description: Resolves which region-config applies from the fields a real host system (e.g. C4C) actually sends — a customer's Origin of Data + salesOrg — without the caller ever needing to know our internal region codes. One (ood, salesOrg) pair = one versioned, effective-dated document, scoped exactly like region-config and supplier-config. salesOrg "*" is an ood-wide default. `region` on a pricing request always wins when the caller supplies it explicitly (same 'explicit selection always wins' precedence as cost-candidate selection and MROQ override) — this table only fires when region is omitted.

ood.description: The customer's Origin of Data (e.g. "SMA", "SAP", "CN", "IN") — distinct from an item's own ood, which can diverge on a single order (see party-config.schema.json).

region.description: The region code this (ood, salesOrg) combination resolves to, e.g. "EUROPE".

entityLabel.description: Human-readable TSS legal entity name, e.g. "TSS Germany" — for display/audit only, never read by engine-core.
